**Finding: compliant — no redline proposed.**

Section 18 (¶¶ p0074–p0075) already satisfies the INSURANCE rule in full:

| Preferred position | Document (§ 18.1) |
|---|---|
| CGL USD 1M/occ, 2M agg | ✅ Matches exactly |
| Professional / E&O USD 2M | ✅ Matches exactly |
| Cyber/privacy USD 5M (Customer Data) | ✅ Matches; warranted since Vendor hosts and processes Customer Data (§§ 15, 17) |
| Workers' comp as required by law | ✅ Plus employer's liability USD 1M (extra) |
| Certificates on request | ✅ § 18.2 |

The clause also exceeds our position on several points in our favor: the term-plus-one-year duration tracks our model language, and § 18.2 adds reputable-insurer and primary-coverage requirements, advance notice of cancellation or material reduction, and an express statement that insurance does not limit Vendor's liabilities — which preserves our recovery under the indemnity and liability provisions (§§ 20, 21).

The obligation runs entirely against Brightline (Vendor) and benefits us, so there is nothing to push back on. No fallback discussion needed.
